segment: Small local service businesses (including home services) in the US that buy shared marketplace leads or respond slowly to leads
signals: Public complaints about lead marketplace costs or shared leads
Mentions of missed calls or slow callbacks
Use of marketplace or lead-form channels
disqualifiers: Large multi-location operator with a sales team
Already uses AI follow-up such as Hatch
search_strategy: Search contractor and small business forums for complaints about shared leads and slow response
Look for owner posts comparing cost per booked job
potential_problem: Owner may say publicly that marketplace leads are shared, close poorly and cost too much, or that follow-up is slow. Vendor-claimed market statistics apply to contractors, not proven for Evorove's stated segment.
solution_mechanism: Evorove finds prospects outside shared marketplaces and runs the conversation continuously, which may reduce dependence on shared leads and slow follow-up.
evidence_requirements: Public statement by the owner about lead cost, quality or response delays
Confirmation of small local service business status in the US
attractiveness_assumptions: Pain from shared lead costs may transfer beyond contractors, which is unverified
Owners may prefer a flat monthly price to per-lead billing

segment: Local independent repair shops in the US (phone, appliance, auto or similar)
signals: Public complaints about slow periods or reliance on walk-ins
Shop run by owner-technician with no sales staff
Reliance on marketplace or directory leads
Unanswered messages or reviews mentioning slow replies
disqualifiers: Already uses a comparable outbound sales service
search_strategy: Search public forums, local groups and shop profiles for owner comments on slow work or lead quality
Check review pages for slow-response complaints
Prioritize shops with a clear appointment process
potential_problem: Owner may say publicly that work is inconsistent and they cannot spend time on sales outreach. This is an inference to test.
solution_mechanism: Evorove finds likely customers in the open web and sells toward a booked appointment or drop-off hour, without the owner closing.
evidence_requirements: Public owner or shop statement about slow demand or lack of sales time
Evidence the shop offers bookable appointments
attractiveness_assumptions: Repair shops value booked appointments over raw leads
Flat $199/mo compares well with per-lead costs, though effectiveness is unproven
Private beta availability may limit access
